published_as: Local APK for owner verification; coordinator publishes the Release
supersedes: 1.9.3 (memory hardening did not fix the reported force close)
changes: Root cause fixed: ChapletVariables no longer compiles a static Regex with unescaped closing braces; Android ICU rejected it with PatternSyntaxException and produced ExceptionInInitializerError on entering RosaryScreen.
Markers are now parsed by indexOf; behaviour for {{nombre}}, {{intencion}} and gender variants is unchanged.
Keeps the 1.9.3 image-sampling hardening (decode never exceeds requested width, 720 px cap, 24 MB cache).
tests: 18/18 on ChapletVariables markers, chaplet guides, image budget, Rosary/chaplet entry and crash recorder
known_limitations: Owner must confirm on a physical phone; the 1.9.4 fix is derived from the exact stack trace supplied for 1.9.3.
